title: Cisco Q3 Earnings Preview: Margin Focus As Shares Trade Near Highs
text: Shares in CSCO have rallied 25% since my last update in February, with most of those gains earned over the past month. The stock's rally is despite a margin and profitability outlook that I view as underwhelming. The company will be releasing its fiscal Q3 on Wednesday, May 13.

title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy?
text: Cisco (CSCO) possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely earnings beat in its upcoming report. Get prepared with the key expectations.

title: Is It Worth Investing in Cisco (CSCO) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
text: The recommendations of Wall Street analysts are often relied on by investors when deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold a stock. Media reports about these brokerage-firm-employed (or sell-side) analysts changing their ratings often affect a stock's price.

title: Cisco Schedules Conference Call for Q3 Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
text: SAN JOSE, Calif., May 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cisco (NASDAQ: CSCO) has scheduled a conference call for Wednesday, May 13, 2026, at 1:30 PM (PT); 4:30 PM (ET) to announce its third quarter fiscal year 2026 financial results for the period ending Saturday, April 25, 2026.
